project_type: Multi-service monorepo for a Chhath committee portal: Cloudflare Workers (mgmt backend + public backend), Vercel-hosted frontends (React SPA + SvelteKit apps), a Render.com Node/Express offload service, and D1/Neon databases. Everything auto-deploys on merge to main.
language: JavaScript (Workers, Node/Express, React), TypeScript (SvelteKit apps), SQL (D1 schema + migrations)
build_system: Per-service npm. mgmt/backend + Public/backend are Cloudflare Workers (wrangler). mgmt/frontend is React on vite 5. mgmt/frontend-svelte + Public/frontend-v6 are SvelteKit on vite 8 / vitest 5 (Node toolchain upgraded in PR-47). mgmt/server-render is Node >=18 Express with deps express+pg and NO package-lock.json (render.yaml uses npm install, not npm ci, deliberately).
test_framework: mgmt/backend: node --test with node:sqlite as the D1 stub and a Map as KV (Node 22 required). mgmt/server-render: node --test test/*.test.mjs. SvelteKit apps: vitest. React app (mgmt/frontend): ZERO tests today (carry-over C2) — a vitest+jsdom+testing-library harness must be added.
build_command: Per service: (mgmt/backend) npm test; (mgmt/server-render) npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test; (mgmt/frontend) npm ci && npm run build; (SvelteKit) npm ci && npm run check && npm test && npm run build. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs all of these.
test_command: cd mgmt/backend && npm test  (Worker suite, ~220 assertions). cd mgmt/server-render && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test. cd mgmt/frontend && npm ci && npm test (after harness is added). SQL: node --test on migration-matrix + h10-m38-indexes-and-retention etc.
verification_instructions: 1) mgmt/backend: `cd mgmt/backend && npm test` must stay green (collection queue P0-03/P0-04, retention, c2-convertdocx-authorization). 2) mgmt/server-render: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test` (pdfConvert, batchContract drift, jobClaims). 3) render-batch-contract drift test in mgmt/backend reads BOTH renderContract.js and batchContract.js and fails on drift — any contract change must keep it passing. 4) mgmt/frontend: `npm ci && npm test && npm run build` and the 230kB main-chunk budget (currently ~218.33kB). 5) The react-router guard test mgmt/frontend-svelte/src/lib/reactRouterExposure.test.ts is DESIGNED to fail once mgmt/frontend is on react-router-dom >=7.18.0 and MUST be deleted in the same PR that upgrades. 6) DB rebuild: build a fresh sqlite from mgmt/db/schema/*.sql then apply the seed migrations and assert row counts.
snapshot_or_generated_files: No committed snapshot/golden files exist yet. Part A REQUIRES creating one: a golden baseline of the CURRENT browser-rendered .docx bytes for a known template+data, captured on main FIRST, so the server-side renderer can be proven byte-equivalent (delimiters {}, nullGetter blanks-and-records, 1x1 blank-PNG image fallback). Store it as a test fixture under the renderer's package.
setup_instructions: PATH must be PREPENDED not replaced: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (replacing loses gh + coreutils). Node 22 is required for node:sqlite. Repo is at /projects/sandbox/chhath-full-codebase on main (commit 3cc8529), clean. COMMIT before any mutation-test/experiment that reverts files — /tmp does NOT persist across shell calls and git checkout -- discards uncommitted work.
environment_constraints: The planner and coder subagents CANNOT push or open PRs — only the orchestrator can. Produce work as commits on a feature branch; do NOT push. gh pr create is GraphQL-backed and fails here; the orchestrator opens PRs via gh api. Everything auto-deploys on merge to main, so main is production. A separate DEPLOYMENT BLOCKER exists (surface only, do not fix from code): the public portal's live Vercel build is stale (live /expenses canonical + 8-URL sitemap vs merged 11-URL) — must be checked in the Vercel dashboard (Production Branch=main, Node 20/22, latest deploy commit + build logs).
contribution_requirements: House method, enforced per PR: (1) prove the defect/behaviour on main FIRST — for the DOCX move that means capturing current rendered-output bytes as a golden baseline before writing the server renderer; (2) mutation-test your own tests (break the code, confirm a test fails; record surviving mutants as equivalent with a reason); (3) COMMIT before mutation-testing; (4) one concern per PR, green CI, squash-merge; (5) document deliberately-deferred items with reasons. CI 'no real data/credentials committed' + GitGuardian gate: never commit PII dumps or secrets.
key_patterns: collection_jobs state machine (P0-03 enqueue authority derives year/recordId/payload from the STORED collections row, never the client; P0-04 exact-state claim with <iso>#<uuid> token + re-read; runOneJob order is generate PDF -> WhatsApp -> email, email in its own try/catch so it can never fail the job). render_jobs offload: createAndDispatchJob (storePayload keeps big blobs OUT of D1) + idempotent handleRenderCallback (atomic applying@<iso> claim, side-effect writes R2 + generated_files, base64-STRIPPED result stored, data-version bump for VERSION_BUMPING_KINDS). Render jobs.js: claim-before-202, 503 at capacity, withDeadline+postResult. Byte contract duplicated byte-identical in renderContract.js (Worker) + batchContract.js (Render) with a drift test. docxFill.js/.ts renderer: delimiters {start:'{',end:'}'}, nullGetter records missing tags + returns '', ImageModule getImage with 1x1 BLANK_PNG_B64 fallback recording missing images, getLastRenderReport() is a MODULE-LEVEL SINGLETON (concurrency bug on Render at jobsMaxConcurrent=3 — report must travel WITH each result). Template bytes cached in KV keyed drive_file_id+updated_at, 7-day TTL, on the WORKER side only. Only the Worker writes R2; Render has no R2 creds and returns bytes. Retention sweep blanks filled_base64 for done (1 day) + failed (30 day) jobs.
